name: Jeremy Bentham
shortBio: English philosopher, jurist, and social reformer who formulated classical utilitarianism, defining moral rightness by the principle of utility and the maximization of net pleasure over pain.
centralQuestion: Can human morality and legislation be rationally organized around a single objective metric: the greatest happiness of the greatest number?

keyWorks.title: An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation
keyWorks.description: Seminal text founding classical utilitarianism, articulating the principle of utility, psychological hedonism, and the felicific calculus.

keyWorks.title: Panopticon; or, The Inspection-House
keyWorks.description: Architectural and penal proposal exploring surveillance, disciplinary power, and behavioral modification.
